name: std-record-detail
description: std-record-detail — single primitive: detail-panel. Owns the fetch-one-record state machine (loading → viewing → error, with RETRY), the record counterpart to std-browse's collection machine. Consumers configure fields/sections/actions and the title/subtitle/status bindings; the atom fetches by the id (or, for slug-routed records, the slug) carried on INIT and renders the panel. `detailLook` (panel default / slide-over / page / document) selects the render body, exactly as std-browse's browseLook selects a collection shape. The `document` look is for records whose shape IS a document (wiki page, note, article): the pure writing surface — a big inline-editable title with the rich-text body DIRECTLY beneath it, Edit/Done and the actions menu tucked into the header corner — where clicking the body drops a cursor in, every typing pause autosaves (CONTENT_SAVED, which the host persists QUIETLY — no refetch, or the editor unmounts mid-keystroke), and Done emits CONTENT_COMMITTED (the host refetches and snapshots version history on this one). Metadata never sits between the title and the words: compose the sibling RecordItemDetails trait beside the doc for a Gutenberg-style settings rail. A row minted blank by a document-first create arrives with draft=1 on INIT and opens straight in the editor. Pair with std-detail-layout for the back + breadcrumb chrome — that atom owns navigation, this one owns the record — exactly as a list page pairs std-browse with std-app-layout.

fields.name: description
fields.description: A textual explanation or summary of the record.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: URL-friendly identifier, for records opened by address instead of id.

fields.name: content
fields.description: The record's rich-text body as HTML, edited in place by the document look.

fields.name: coverUrl
fields.description: The document look's cover/hero image URL, stamped from the loaded row's coverField.

fields.name: iconName
fields.description: The document look's icon name, stamped from the loaded row's iconField.

fields.name: loadedRow
fields.description: The full row exactly as last fetched (relations hydrated when config.include asks). The details drawer binds it, and hosts that need it (e.g. a settings modal) stash it from RecordItemLoaded — the document panel itself takes only scalar props and emits scalar payloads ({ id, title }).

fields.name: openDraft
fields.description: Set from the navigate payload when the surface was opened on a record that was JUST minted blank; read once the row loads to decide whether the document body opens authoring (draft) or read-only. Absent on a refresh or a normal open, so the draft entry never repeats.
fields.synonyms: new document, just created, draft open

emits.description: Signals that the record has been successfully loaded.
A slug-routed record finished loading; the payload is a collection whose first element is the record. Composing traits that need the loaded row (comments scoping, status controls) listen to this.
emits.synonyms: loaded by address, slug resolved, record found

emits.description: Indicates a failure to load the record.
Signals a request to edit the record being viewed.
Signals a request to remove the record being viewed.

The document look's autosave stream: fired at every typing pause while editing, and once more on Done. This atom never persists — the composing organism routes CONTENT_SAVED into a QUIET persist (one that does not refetch or repaint this surface, or the editor unmounts mid-keystroke).
emits.synonyms: autosave, saved, persist content, draft saved

emits.description: The author finished the document editing session (pressed Done). Hosts refetch the row, repaint, and snapshot version history on THIS event — never on the CONTENT_SAVED autosave stream.
The viewer renamed the record in place by editing the document title; carries the committed title and the row id for a partial persist.
emits.synonyms: rename, retitle, change title, edit title

emits.description: The viewer clicked the document body (or its Edit button) to start an editing session.
emits.synonyms: edit, start editing, click to edit

emits.description: The viewer pressed Done to end the document editing session.

events.name: Initialize
events.description: Opens the detail surface for one record: by id, or by slug for address-routed records (the internal re-fetch after an update still carries id). `draft` is set only by a document-first create's navigate, and opens the document look's body straight in the editor.
events.synonyms: open record, view record, show details, drill in

events.name: Content Saved
events.description: The document look's autosave stream: fired at every typing pause while editing, and once more on Done. This atom never persists — the composing organism routes CONTENT_SAVED into a QUIET persist (one that does not refetch or repaint this surface, or the editor unmounts mid-keystroke).
events.synonyms: autosave, saved, persist content, draft saved

events.name: Content Committed
events.description: The author finished the document editing session (pressed Done). Hosts refetch the row, repaint, and snapshot version history on THIS event — never on the CONTENT_SAVED autosave stream.
events.synonyms: done, finished editing, commit, snapshot

events.name: Title Committed
events.description: The viewer renamed the record in place by editing the document title; carries the committed title and the row id for a partial persist.
events.synonyms: rename, retitle, change title, edit title

events.name: Open View
events.description: A row was opened from a list; shows that record in this surface.
events.synonyms: open record, view row, show details, drill in, expand

events.name: RecordItem loaded
events.description: Signals that the record has been successfully loaded.
events.synonyms: loaded, received, ready, fetched

events.name: RecordItem slug loaded
events.description: A slug-routed record finished loading; the payload is a collection whose first element is the record. Composing traits that need the loaded row (comments scoping, status controls) listen to this.
events.synonyms: loaded by address, slug resolved, record found

events.name: RecordItem load failed
events.description: Indicates a failure to load the record.
events.synonyms: error, failed, problem, unsuccessful

events.name: Content Change
events.description: The rich text surface reported an edit (already debounced to typing pauses by the component).
events.synonyms: typing, content changed, body edited

events.name: Done Editing
events.description: The viewer pressed Done to end the document editing session.
events.synonyms: done, finish, stop editing

events.name: Close View
events.description: Closes the record surface and returns it to blank.
events.synonyms: close, dismiss, back to list

events.name: Edit Content
events.description: The viewer clicked the document body (or its Edit button) to start an editing session.
events.synonyms: edit, start editing, click to edit

events.name: Retry
events.description: Re-runs the fetch after a failed load.
events.synonyms: try again, reload, refresh

events.name: Edit
events.description: Signals a request to edit the record being viewed.
events.synonyms: modify, update, change

events.name: Delete
events.description: Signals a request to remove the record being viewed.
events.synonyms: remove, discard, delete, archive

editLabel.label: Edit button label
editLabel.description: Label of the quiet button above the document body that starts an editing session (the body itself is also clickable).

actions.label: What actions can users take on this record?
actions.description: Buttons on the panel header. One primary at most; the rest collapse past maxInlineActions.
actions.synonyms: record actions, detail actions, panel buttons

placeholder.label: Placeholder text
placeholder.description: Placeholder shown in the document body when it is empty.

bodyContent.label: Body content tree
bodyContent.description: Render-ui SExpr rendered after the record loads when detailLook = panel (the default). See slideOverBodyContent/pageBodyContent for the other looks; any may be overridden directly while inheriting the same trait, state machine, emits, and listens.

subtitleField.label: Which field is the subtitle?
subtitleField.description: Name of the field shown under the title (e.g. company, category). Set to "" for no subtitle at all — the right choice for the document look, whose metadata lives in the properties strip, not a second line.
subtitleField.synonyms: subtitle field, secondary field, subheading, no subtitle

allowEdit.label: Allow editing the document?
allowEdit.description: When false the document look is a pure read surface: no header Edit button, no click-to-edit body, no click-to-rename title. Hosts pass a role condition here so read-only viewers get the page without its authoring affordances; the entity's own access predicates stay the enforcement floor.
allowEdit.synonyms: read only document, viewer mode, can edit, editing allowed

pageBodyContent.label: Page look body
pageBodyContent.description: Render-ui SExpr rendered after the record loads when detailLook = page: a full record page, width-capped so field rows do not stretch past a readable measure (Almadar_UI_Beauty.md §3).

titleField.label: Which field is the record's title?
titleField.description: Name of the field on the loaded record shown as the panel title (e.g. contactName, subject, title).
titleField.synonyms: title field, heading field, name field, label field

documentEditingContent.label: Document look body (editing)
documentEditingContent.description: Render-ui SExpr for detailLook = document during an editing session: the same surface with the body live and the header corner showing the autosave hint + Done. Binds only @entity fields, never ?data.

sections.label: How should the fields be grouped?
sections.description: Optional titled groups over `fields`, e.g. [{title: Contact, fields: [email, phone]}]. Group into sections of 3-5 once a record carries more than about seven fields — a flat list past that is the cognitive-load problem Almadar_UX.md §1.4 (Miller) describes. Empty = one ungrouped list, the default.
sections.synonyms: field groups, grouped fields, panel sections, fieldsets

fields.label: Which fields appear in the record panel?
fields.description: Each entry maps one entity field to a labelled row in the panel. Unlike a list row, a detail panel SHOULD label every field — the value stands alone here with no column header or repeated row position to name it.
fields.synonyms: detail fields, record fields, panel fields, shown fields

autosaveHint.label: Autosave hint
autosaveHint.description: Muted caption next to the Done button telling the author their work persists on its own.

coverField.label: Which field is the cover image?
coverField.description: Name of the image-typed field on the loaded record painted as the document look's full-bleed hero banner (e.g. coverImage, heroImage). Empty = no banner, the default.
coverField.synonyms: cover field, hero image field, banner field

detailLook.label: Detail look
detailLook.description: Visual treatment for the record surface. panel = an inline detail-panel in the page flow (bodyContent); slide-over = the same panel as a right-hand drawer over the list behind it (slideOverBodyContent); page = a full-width record page with roomier spacing (pageBodyContent); document = a wiki-page/note/article surface — big editable title over a rich-text body, no labelled field rows, click-to-edit with autosave (documentBodyContent / documentEditingContent). Selecting a look swaps which body tree renders after the record loads; any body may still be overridden directly at the call site.
detailLook.synonyms: detail style, drawer, slide over, full page, document, wiki page, note, article

include.label: Which relation fields to hydrate?
include.description: Entity relation field names to hydrate on fetch, so panel fields can use dot-paths like owner.name. Empty = no hydration, the default.
include.synonyms: relation hydration, populate relations, joined fields

maxInlineActions.label: How many actions before collapsing?
maxInlineActions.description: Actions beyond this count collapse into a '⋯' overflow menu.

documentBodyContent.label: Document look body (reading)
documentBodyContent.description: Render-ui SExpr for detailLook = document while reading: the pure writing surface — editable title with the rich-text body DIRECTLY beneath it, Edit and the actions menu tucked into the header corner. Metadata never sits between title and content; compose the sibling RecordItemDetails trait beside this one for the settings rail. Binds only @entity fields, never ?data, because it is also painted by arms whose payload is not the record.

contentField.label: Which field holds the document body?
contentField.description: Name of the field on the loaded record that carries the rich-text HTML body the document look renders and edits (e.g. content, body, articleText).
contentField.synonyms: body field, content field, document field

openOn.label: When does this surface load?
openOn.description: init = a routed detail page; the record loads as soon as the page mounts (the default). event = an overlay that stays blank until a row-click OPEN_VIEW hands it an id, which is what a list-embedded slide-over needs — mounting an init-loading surface on a list page would fetch a record it has no id for.
openOn.synonyms: open on click, slide over, row click, blank until opened, list embedded

doneLabel.label: Done button label
doneLabel.description: Label of the button that ends the document editing session; work is already autosaved when it is pressed.

iconField.label: Which field is the document icon?
iconField.description: Name of the field on the loaded record whose icon name renders beside the document title (e.g. icon). Empty = no icon, the default.

slideOverBodyContent.label: Slide-over look body
slideOverBodyContent.description: Render-ui SExpr rendered after the record loads when detailLook = slide-over: the same panel as a right-hand drawer, so the list behind stays in place. Use when the record is a glance, not a workspace.

showActions.label: Show the action buttons?
showActions.description: Set false for a read-only record view; a panel with actions nothing listens to is a dead affordance.
showActions.synonyms: read only, hide actions, view only

emits.description: A property in the settings rail committed in place; patch carries the row id plus the one changed field, ready to hand straight to a persist update. Quiet contract: the host persists without refetching or repainting the open document.
emits.synonyms: property saved, metadata changed, field committed, update property

emits.description: A relation chip in the details drawer was clicked (a tag, the author, the category); id is the linked row's id. Hosts route it to the linked record's own surface — a navigate, a scoped overlay, a filtered list.
emits.synonyms: open relation, linked record clicked, tag clicked, chip clicked

events.name: Show Details
events.description: The document finished loading; stash the row the details drawer will show. Hosts route the doc trait's RecordItemLoaded (or SlugLoaded first element) here.
events.synonyms: record loaded, show metadata, populate details

events.name: Open Details
events.description: Open the details drawer. Hosts route the document's Details action (e.g. Doc.VIEW_INFO) here.
events.synonyms: show info, open details, document info, page info

events.name: Meta Saved
events.description: A property in the settings rail committed in place; patch carries the row id plus the one changed field, ready to hand straight to a persist update. Quiet contract: the host persists without refetching or repainting the open document.
events.synonyms: property saved, metadata changed, field committed, update property

events.name: Close
events.description: Close the details drawer; the drawer chrome's X / backdrop dismiss emits this.
events.synonyms: dismiss, close drawer, hide details

events.name: Meta Change
events.description: A property in the rail committed (switch toggled, select changed, text blurred).
events.synonyms: property changed, metadata edited, field committed

events.name: Relation Open
events.description: A relation chip in the details drawer was clicked (a tag, the author, the category); id is the linked row's id. Hosts route it to the linked record's own surface — a navigate, a scoped overlay, a filtered list.
events.synonyms: open relation, linked record clicked, tag clicked, chip clicked

detailsContent.label: Details drawer content tree
detailsContent.description: Render-ui SExpr painted into the drawer slot on OPEN_DETAILS; binds the row stashed by SHOW_DETAILS. Info-only by default — no metaCommitEvent, so every row displays rather than edits (editing rides the document's actions menu). Override at the call site to extend the panel or to opt into in-place commits via metaCommitEvent: META_CHANGE.

detailsTitle.label: Details drawer heading
detailsTitle.description: Heading of the settings card (e.g. Details, Page info, Document settings).

metaFields.label: Which metadata properties appear in the details drawer?
metaFields.description: The record's metadata shown as read-only INFO in the details drawer (Updated, address, status, …). Editing metadata is a normal action under the document's menu, not an inline affordance here.
metaFields.synonyms: properties, metadata fields, document info, page info, front matter

lolo:
app std-record-detail "1.0.0"
"std-record-detail — single primitive: detail-panel. Owns the fetch-one-record state machine (loading → viewing → error, with RETRY), the record counterpart to std-browse's collection machine. Consumers configure fields/sections/actions and the title/subtitle/status bindings; the atom fetches by the id (or, for slug-routed records, the slug) carried on INIT and renders the panel. `detailLook` (panel default / slide-over / page / document) selects the render body, exactly as std-browse's browseLook selects a collection shape. The `document` look is for records whose shape IS a document (wiki page, note, article): the pure writing surface — a big inline-editable title with the rich-text body DIRECTLY beneath it, Edit/Done and the actions menu tucked into the header corner — where clicking the body drops a cursor in, every typing pause autosaves (CONTENT_SAVED, which the host persists QUIETLY — no refetch, or the editor unmounts mid-keystroke), and Done emits CONTENT_COMMITTED (the host refetches and snapshots version history on this one). Metadata never sits between the title and the words: compose the sibling RecordItemDetails trait beside the doc for a Gutenberg-style settings rail. A row minted blank by a document-first create arrives with draft=1 on INIT and opens straight in the editor. Pair with std-detail-layout for the back + breadcrumb chrome — that atom owns navigation, this one owns the record — exactly as a list page pairs std-browse with std-app-layout."
;; @capabilities "record detail, single record view, entity detail panel, drill-down record, show one record, record profile, detail page, view details, document editor, wiki page, note taking, article body, rich text editing, write and edit content"
orbital RecordItemOrbital {
  type RecordAction = { label : string!, event : event!, icon : string, variant : primary | secondary | ghost | danger }
  type RecordFieldSpec = { key : string!, header : string, format : date | currency | number | boolean | percent }
  type MetaFieldSpec = { key : string!, label : string, kind : text | boolean | select | readonly, options : [string], icon : string, format : date | currency | number | boolean | percent }
  type RecordSection = { title : string!, fields : [string] }

  type RecordItemLoaded = Event { data : RecordItem, totalCount : number } "Fired when the single record finishes loading; payload.data holds the record. totalCount is accepted so a fetch emitter shared with collection atoms still validates."

  type RecordItemSlugLoaded = Event { data : [RecordItem], totalCount : number } "Fired when a slug-routed record finishes loading. The fetch filters on the slug field, so the payload is a collection — (array/first ?data) is the record, and an empty array means no record matches the address."

  type RecordItemLoadFailed = Event { error : string, code : string } "Fired when the record fails to load; drives the error state so a failed load shows an alert with a retry instead of an empty page."

  entity RecordItem [runtime] {
    id : string!
    name : string! @description "The record's title or identifier." @synonyms "title, label, heading"
    description : string @description "A textual explanation or summary of the record." @synonyms "summary, details, notes"
    status : "active" | "inactive" | "pending" @description "The record's current state." @synonyms "state, condition, stage" = active
    slug : string @description "URL-friendly identifier, for records opened by address instead of id." @synonyms "permalink, url key, address" = ""
    content : string @description "The record's rich-text body as HTML, edited in place by the document look." @synonyms "body, text, document, article body" = ""
    coverUrl : string @intrinsic @description "The document look's cover/hero image URL, stamped from the loaded row's coverField." = ""
    iconName : string @intrinsic @description "The document look's icon name, stamped from the loaded row's iconField." = ""
    loadedRow : Map string scalar @intrinsic @description "The full row exactly as last fetched (relations hydrated when config.include asks). The details drawer binds it, and hosts that need it (e.g. a settings modal) stash it from RecordItemLoaded — the document panel itself takes only scalar props and emits scalar payloads ({ id, title })." = {}
    openDraft : string @intrinsic @description "Set from the navigate payload when the surface was opened on a record that was JUST minted blank; read once the row loads to decide whether the document body opens authoring (draft) or read-only. Absent on a refresh or a normal open, so the draft entry never repeats." @synonyms "new document, just created, draft open" = ""
    createdAt : string
  }

  trait RecordItemDetail -> @rebindable RecordItem [interaction, instance] {
    ;; One machine, two shapes. A page detail (`openOn: init`, the default)
    ;; falls straight through idle on INIT and behaves exactly as before. An
    ;; overlay (`openOn: event`) stays blank until a row-click OPEN_VIEW hands
    ;; it an id, which is the topology 23 hand-authored viewer traits use and
    ;; the reason they could not compose an `initial: loading` atom: mounting
    ;; one on a list page would fetch a record it has no id for.
    initial: idle

    state idle {
      INIT -> loading when (and ["=", @config.openOn, "init"] ["!=", (str/default ?id ""), ""])
        (set @entity.id ?id)
        (set @entity.openDraft (str/default ?draft ""))
        (fetch RecordItem {
          emit: { failure: RecordItemLoadFailed, success: RecordItemLoaded }
          id: ?id
          include: @config.include
        })
        (render-ui main { rows: 4, type: skeleton })
      ;; Slug-routed open (/things/:slug): no id on the payload, so fetch by
      ;; the slug field instead. Filtered rather than by-id, so the success
      ;; payload is a collection — its own event keeps the two shapes honest.
      INIT -> loading when (and ["=", @config.openOn, "init"] ["=", (str/default ?id ""), ""] ["!=", (str/default ?slug ""), ""])
        (set @entity.slug ?slug)
        (set @entity.openDraft (str/default ?draft ""))
        (fetch RecordItem {
          filter: ["=", (object/get @entity slug), ?slug]
          emit: { failure: RecordItemLoadFailed, success: RecordItemSlugLoaded }
          include: @config.include
        })
        (render-ui main { rows: 4, type: skeleton })
      ;; Fallback: an init-opened surface whose INIT carried neither key —
      ;; fetch by the (missing) id so the failure surfaces as the error
      ;; state's alert + Retry instead of a silent blank page. This is the
      ;; pre-slug atom's exact behavior, kept as the explicit last arm.
      INIT -> loading when (and ["=", @config.openOn, "init"] ["=", (str/default ?id ""), ""] ["=", (str/default ?slug ""), ""])
        (set @entity.openDraft (str/default ?draft ""))
        (fetch RecordItem {
          emit: { failure: RecordItemLoadFailed, success: RecordItemLoaded }
          id: ?id
          include: @config.include
        })
        (render-ui main { rows: 4, type: skeleton })
      ;; Event-opened overlay (openOn: event): stays blank until OPEN_VIEW,
      ;; but renders the blank EXPLICITLY — an embedded @trait.X reference to
      ;; a trait with no indexed content is flagged by the compiled client's
      ;; render probe (trait_bindings_resolved).
      INIT -> idle when ["=", @config.openOn, "event"]
        (render-ui main null)
      ;; self-loops on the external emits so the validator sees in-atom
      ;; listeners — the real consumers are the composing organism's
      ;; persistor (CONTENT_SAVED, TITLE_COMMITTED) and its refetch /
      ;; revision path (CONTENT_COMMITTED).
      CONTENT_SAVED -> idle
      CONTENT_COMMITTED -> idle
      TITLE_COMMITTED -> idle
      ;; ONE unguarded arm on purpose. This briefly carried a second,
      ;; `when @config.preloaded`-guarded arm that rendered the OPEN_VIEW row
      ;; directly to skip a round-trip. Both execution paths mishandled it:
      ;; the live runtime PASSED the guard with `preloaded: false`
      ;; (StateMachineCore's permissive mode turns an unresolved config guard
      ;; into true), so overlays rendered from `?row` and never fetched —
      ;; silently skipping `include` relation hydration; and the canonical
      ;; evaluator FAILED the guard and then did not fall through to this arm,
      ;; reporting the event as not firing at all. A guarded arm is not
      ;; currently a trustworthy correctness boundary, so the atom no longer
      ;; depends on one. Zero consumers had opted into the skip.
      OPEN_VIEW -> loading
        (set @entity.id ?id)
        (fetch RecordItem {
          emit: { failure: RecordItemLoadFailed, success: RecordItemLoaded }
          id: ?id
          include: @config.include
        })
        (render-ui main { rows: 4, type: skeleton })
    }

    state loading {
      INIT -> loading when ["!=", (str/default ?id ""), ""]
        (set @entity.id ?id)
        (set @entity.openDraft (str/default ?draft ""))
        (fetch RecordItem {
          emit: { failure: RecordItemLoadFailed, success: RecordItemLoaded }
          id: ?id
          include: @config.include
        })
        ;; Skeleton, not a blank frame: the hand-authored detail traits this
        ;; atom replaces rendered nothing until the record arrived.
        (render-ui main { rows: 4, type: skeleton })
      INIT -> loading when (and ["=", (str/default ?id ""), ""] ["!=", (str/default ?slug ""), ""])
        (set @entity.slug ?slug)
        (set @entity.openDraft (str/default ?draft ""))
        (fetch RecordItem {
          filter: ["=", (object/get @entity slug), ?slug]
          emit: { failure: RecordItemLoadFailed, success: RecordItemSlugLoaded }
          include: @config.include
        })
        (render-ui main { rows: 4, type: skeleton })
      ;; A record minted blank by a document-first create arrives with
      ;; draft=1 and lands straight in the editor — a distinct target state,
      ;; not a flag on the render, so the machine stays honest about being
      ;; in an editing session.
      RecordItemLoaded -> editing when ["=", (str/default (object/get @entity openDraft) ""), "1"]
        ;; (object/merge … {}) is a type adapter only: type_compat lacks "declared object accepts a named row type" (ledgered)
        (set @entity.loadedRow (object/merge ?data {}))
        (set @entity.id (object/get ?data id))
        (set @entity.name (object/get ?data @config.titleField))
        (set @entity.description (str/default (object/get ?data @config.subtitleField) ""))
        (set @entity.content (object/get ?data @config.contentField))
        (set @entity.coverUrl (str/default (object/get ?data @config.coverField) ""))
        (set @entity.iconName (str/default (object/get ?data @config.iconField) ""))
        (render-ui main @config.documentEditingContent)
      RecordItemLoaded -> viewing when ["!=", (str/default (object/get @entity openDraft) ""), "1"]
        ;; (object/merge … {}) is a type adapter only: type_compat lacks "declared object accepts a named row type" (ledgered)
        (set @entity.loadedRow (object/merge ?data {}))
        (set @entity.id (object/get ?data id))
        (set @entity.name (object/get ?data @config.titleField))
        (set @entity.description (str/default (object/get ?data @config.subtitleField) ""))
        (set @entity.content (object/get ?data @config.contentField))
        (set @entity.coverUrl (str/default (object/get ?data @config.coverField) ""))
        (set @entity.iconName (str/default (object/get ?data @config.iconField) ""))
        (if ["=", @config.detailLook, document]
          (render-ui main @config.documentBodyContent)
          (if ["=", @config.detailLook, slide-over]
            (render-ui main @config.slideOverBodyContent)
            (if ["=", @config.detailLook, page]
              (render-ui main @config.pageBodyContent)
              (render-ui main @config.bodyContent))))
      RecordItemSlugLoaded -> editing when (and [">", (array/len ?data), 0] ["=", (str/default (object/get @entity openDraft) ""), "1"])
        (set @entity.loadedRow (array/first ?data))
        (set @entity.id (object/get (array/first ?data) id))
        (set @entity.name (object/get (array/first ?data) @config.titleField))
        (set @entity.description (str/default (object/get (array/first ?data) @config.subtitleField) ""))
        (set @entity.content (object/get (array/first ?data) @config.contentField))
        (set @entity.coverUrl (str/default (object/get (array/first ?data) @config.coverField) ""))
        (set @entity.iconName (str/default (object/get (array/first ?data) @config.iconField) ""))
        (render-ui main @config.documentEditingContent)
      RecordItemSlugLoaded -> viewing when (and [">", (array/len ?data), 0] ["!=", (str/default (object/get @entity openDraft) ""), "1"])
        (set @entity.loadedRow (array/first ?data))
        (set @entity.id (object/get (array/first ?data) id))
        (set @entity.name (object/get (array/first ?data) @config.titleField))
        (set @entity.description (str/default (object/get (array/first ?data) @config.subtitleField) ""))
        (set @entity.content (object/get (array/first ?data) @config.contentField))
        (set @entity.coverUrl (str/default (object/get (array/first ?data) @config.coverField) ""))
        (set @entity.iconName (str/default (object/get (array/first ?data) @config.iconField) ""))
        (if ["=", @config.detailLook, document]
          (render-ui main @config.documentBodyContent)
          (if ["=", @config.detailLook, slide-over]
            (render-ui main @config.slideOverBodyContent)
            (if ["=", @config.detailLook, page]
              (render-ui main @config.pageBodyContent)
              (render-ui main @config.bodyContent))))
      RecordItemSlugLoaded -> error when ["=", (array/len ?data), 0]
        (render-ui main { description: "No record matches this address.", icon: search-x, title: "Not found", type: empty-state })
      RecordItemLoadFailed -> error
        (render-ui main { message: ?error, title: "Couldn't load this record", type: alert, variant: error })
    }

    ;; The document look's editing session. Reached from a draft landing or
    ;; the read view's EDIT_CONTENT; every typing pause autosaves through
    ;; CONTENT_SAVED, and Done commits. INIT is handled ONLY for a
    ;; DIFFERENT record: a page navigation (open another note, open a
    ;; just-minted subpage) delivers INIT and must not be swallowed — the
    ;; session's server-side trait state survives navigation, so an
    ;; INIT-less editing state left every later record page blank. The
    ;; SAME record's INIT (the refetch echo after an update) stays
    ;; unhandled on purpose: a repaint would unmount the editor under the
    ;; author mid-keystroke. Work is already autosaved when we leave.
    state editing {
      INIT -> loading when (and ["!=", (str/default ?id ""), ""] ["!=", ?id, @entity.id])
        (set @entity.id ?id)
        (set @entity.openDraft (str/default ?draft ""))
        (fetch RecordItem {
          emit: { failure: RecordItemLoadFailed, success: RecordItemLoaded }
          id: ?id
          include: @config.include
        })
        (render-ui main { rows: 4, type: skeleton })
      INIT -> loading when (and ["=", (str/default ?id ""), ""] ["!=", (str/default ?slug ""), ""] ["!=", ?slug, @entity.slug])
        (set @entity.slug ?slug)
        (set @entity.openDraft (str/default ?draft ""))
        (fetch RecordItem {
          filter: ["=", (object/get @entity slug), ?slug]
          emit: { failure: RecordItemLoadFailed, success: RecordItemSlugLoaded }
          include: @config.include
        })
        (render-ui main { rows: 4, type: skeleton })
      CONTENT_CHANGE -> editing
        (set @entity.content ?value)
        (set @entity.loadedRow (object/set @entity.loadedRow @config.contentField ?value))
        (emit CONTENT_SAVED { id: @entity.id, content: @entity.content })
      TITLE_COMMITTED -> editing
        (set @entity.name ?title)
        (set @entity.loadedRow (object/set @entity.loadedRow @config.titleField ?title))
      DONE_EDITING -> viewing
        (emit CONTENT_SAVED { id: @entity.id, content: @entity.content })
        (emit CONTENT_COMMITTED { id: @entity.id, content: @entity.content })
        (render-ui main @config.documentBodyContent)
      ;; The editing card renders the same header actions as the read view,
      ;; so a consumer-configured Close must not be a dead button here:
      ;; flush the autosave stream and close, same contract as Done minus
      ;; the commit.
      CLOSE_VIEW -> idle
        (emit CONTENT_SAVED { id: @entity.id, content: @entity.content })
        (render-ui main null)
    }

    state viewing {
      ;; No skeleton on re-entry: from a populated panel a skeleton unmounts the
      ;; record and flickers. First mount is unaffected — `initial: loading` and
      ;; `state loading`'s own INIT still paint it.
      INIT -> loading when ["!=", (str/default ?id ""), ""]
        (set @entity.id ?id)
        (set @entity.openDraft (str/default ?draft ""))
        (fetch RecordItem {
          emit: { failure: RecordItemLoadFailed, success: RecordItemLoaded }
          id: ?id
          include: @config.include
        })
      INIT -> loading when (and ["=", (str/default ?id ""), ""] ["!=", (str/default ?slug ""), ""])
        (set @entity.slug ?slug)
        (set @entity.openDraft (str/default ?draft ""))
        (fetch RecordItem {
          filter: ["=", (object/get @entity slug), ?slug]
          emit: { failure: RecordItemLoadFailed, success: RecordItemSlugLoaded }
          include: @config.include
        })
      RecordItemLoaded -> viewing
        ;; (object/merge … {}) is a type adapter only: type_compat lacks "declared object accepts a named row type" (ledgered)
        (set @entity.loadedRow (object/merge ?data {}))
        (set @entity.id (object/get ?data id))
        (set @entity.name (object/get ?data @config.titleField))
        (set @entity.description (str/default (object/get ?data @config.subtitleField) ""))
        (set @entity.content (object/get ?data @config.contentField))
        (set @entity.coverUrl (str/default (object/get ?data @config.coverField) ""))
        (set @entity.iconName (str/default (object/get ?data @config.iconField) ""))
        (if ["=", @config.detailLook, document]
          (render-ui main @config.documentBodyContent)
          (if ["=", @config.detailLook, slide-over]
            (render-ui main @config.slideOverBodyContent)
            (if ["=", @config.detailLook, page]
              (render-ui main @config.pageBodyContent)
              (render-ui main @config.bodyContent))))
      RecordItemSlugLoaded -> viewing when [">", (array/len ?data), 0]
        (set @entity.loadedRow (array/first ?data))
        (set @entity.id (object/get (array/first ?data) id))
        (set @entity.name (object/get (array/first ?data) @config.titleField))
        (set @entity.description (str/default (object/get (array/first ?data) @config.subtitleField) ""))
        (set @entity.content (object/get (array/first ?data) @config.contentField))
        (set @entity.coverUrl (str/default (object/get (array/first ?data) @config.coverField) ""))
        (set @entity.iconName (str/default (object/get (array/first ?data) @config.iconField) ""))
        (if ["=", @config.detailLook, document]
          (render-ui main @config.documentBodyContent)
          (if ["=", @config.detailLook, slide-over]
            (render-ui main @config.slideOverBodyContent)
            (if ["=", @config.detailLook, page]
              (render-ui main @config.pageBodyContent)
              (render-ui main @config.bodyContent))))
      RecordItemSlugLoaded -> error when ["=", (array/len ?data), 0]
        (render-ui main { description: "No record matches this address.", icon: search-x, title: "Not found", type: empty-state })
      ;; The document body is its own edit affordance: clicking it (or its
      ;; Edit button) starts the editing session with a cursor in the text.
      EDIT_CONTENT -> editing
        (render-ui main @config.documentEditingContent)
      ;; The title renames from the read view too, without an editing session.
      TITLE_COMMITTED -> viewing
        (set @entity.name ?title)
        (set @entity.loadedRow (object/set @entity.loadedRow @config.titleField ?title))
      RecordItemLoadFailed -> error
        (render-ui main { message: ?error, title: "Couldn't load this record", type: alert, variant: error })
      CLOSE_VIEW -> idle
        (render-ui main null)
    }

    state error {
      INIT -> loading when ["!=", (str/default ?id ""), ""]
        (set @entity.id ?id)
        (set @entity.openDraft (str/default ?draft ""))
        (fetch RecordItem {
          emit: { failure: RecordItemLoadFailed, success: RecordItemLoaded }
          id: ?id
          include: @config.include
        })
        (render-ui main { rows: 4, type: skeleton })
      INIT -> loading when (and ["=", (str/default ?id ""), ""] ["!=", (str/default ?slug ""), ""])
        (set @entity.slug ?slug)
        (set @entity.openDraft (str/default ?draft ""))
        (fetch RecordItem {
          filter: ["=", (object/get @entity slug), ?slug]
          emit: { failure: RecordItemLoadFailed, success: RecordItemSlugLoaded }
          include: @config.include
        })
        (render-ui main { rows: 4, type: skeleton })
      ;; The hand-authored traits sent a failed load back to `loading` with no
      ;; effect, so the page stayed blank forever with no way out. RETRY is the
      ;; way out.
      RETRY -> loading
        (fetch RecordItem {
          emit: { failure: RecordItemLoadFailed, success: RecordItemLoaded }
          id: @entity.id
          include: @config.include
        })
        (render-ui main { rows: 4, type: skeleton })
    }

    emits {
      RecordItemLoaded
        @description "Signals that the record has been successfully loaded."
        @synonyms "loaded, received, ready, fetched"
        @tier "domain"
      RecordItemSlugLoaded
        @description "A slug-routed record finished loading; the payload is a collection whose first element is the record. Composing traits that need the loaded row (comments scoping, status controls) listen to this."
        @synonyms "loaded by address, slug resolved, record found"
        @tier "domain"
      RecordItemLoadFailed
        @description "Indicates a failure to load the record."
        @synonyms "error, failed, problem, unsuccessful"
        @tier "internal"
      EDIT -> external {
        id : string!

        @description "Signals a request to edit the record being viewed."
        @synonyms "modify, update, change"
        @tier "domain"
      DELETE -> external {
        id : string!
        row : RecordItem!

        @description "Signals a request to remove the record being viewed."
        @synonyms "remove, discard, delete, archive"
        @tier "domain"
      CONTENT_SAVED -> external {
        id : string!
        content : string
      }
        @description "The document look's autosave stream: fired at every typing pause while editing, and once more on Done. This atom never persists — the composing organism routes CONTENT_SAVED into a QUIET persist (one that does not refetch or repaint this surface, or the editor unmounts mid-keystroke)."
        @synonyms "autosave, saved, persist content, draft saved"
        @tier "domain"
      CONTENT_COMMITTED -> external {
        id : string!
        content : string
      }
        @description "The author finished the document editing session (pressed Done). Hosts refetch the row, repaint, and snapshot version history on THIS event — never on the CONTENT_SAVED autosave stream."
        @synonyms "done, finished editing, commit, snapshot"
        @tier "domain"
      TITLE_COMMITTED -> external {
        title : string
        id : string
      }
        @description "The viewer renamed the record in place by editing the document title; carries the committed title and the row id for a partial persist."
        @synonyms "rename, retitle, change title, edit title"
        @tier "domain"
      EDIT_CONTENT
        @description "The viewer clicked the document body (or its Edit button) to start an editing session."
        @synonyms "edit, start editing, click to edit"
        @tier "presentation"
      DONE_EDITING
        @description "The viewer pressed Done to end the document editing session."
        @synonyms "done, finish, stop editing"
        @tier "presentation"
    }

    listens {
      INIT {
        id : string
        slug : string
        draft : string
      }
        @description "Opens the detail surface for one record: by id, or by slug for address-routed records (the internal re-fetch after an update still carries id). `draft` is set only by a document-first create's navigate, and opens the document look's body straight in the editor."
        @synonyms "open record, view record, show details, drill in"
        @tier "domain"
      CONTENT_CHANGE {
        value : string
      }
        @description "The rich text surface reported an edit (already debounced to typing pauses by the component)."
        @synonyms "typing, content changed, body edited"
        @tier "domain"
      EDIT_CONTENT
        @description "Start the document editing session."
        @synonyms "edit, start editing, click to edit"
        @tier "presentation"
      DONE_EDITING
        @description "End the document editing session; work is already autosaved when it fires."
        @synonyms "done, finish, stop editing"
        @tier "presentation"
      TITLE_COMMITTED {
        title : string
        id : string
      }
        @description "The document title was renamed in place."
        @synonyms "rename, retitle, change title"
        @tier "domain"
      OPEN_VIEW {
        id : string!
        row : RecordItem!
      }
        @description "A row was opened from a list; shows that record in this surface."
        @synonyms "open record, view row, show details, drill in, expand"
        @tier "domain"
      CLOSE_VIEW
        @description "Closes the record surface and returns it to blank."
        @synonyms "close, dismiss, back to list"
        @tier "domain"
      RETRY
        @description "Re-runs the fetch after a failed load."
        @synonyms "try again, reload, refresh"
        @tier "domain"
      RecordItemLoadFailed {
        error : string
        code : string
      }
        @description "Indicates a failure to load the record."
        @synonyms "error, failure, problem, unsuccessful"
        @tier "internal"
    }

    config {
      fields : [RecordFieldSpec] = [{
        header: Name
        key: name
      }, {
        header: Description
        key: description
      }, {
        header: Status
        key: status
      }, {
        format: date
        header: Created
        key: createdAt
      }]
        @label "Which fields appear in the record panel?"
        @description "Each entry maps one entity field to a labelled row in the panel. Unlike a list row, a detail panel SHOULD label every field — the value stands alone here with no column header or repeated row position to name it."
        @synonyms "detail fields, record fields, panel fields, shown fields"
        @tier "presentation"
      sections : [RecordSection] = []
        @label "How should the fields be grouped?"
        @description "Optional titled groups over `fields`, e.g. [{title: Contact, fields: [email, phone]}]. Group into sections of 3-5 once a record carries more than about seven fields — a flat list past that is the cognitive-load problem Almadar_UX.md §1.4 (Miller) describes. Empty = one ungrouped list, the default."
        @synonyms "field groups, grouped fields, panel sections, fieldsets"
        @tier "presentation"
      actions : [RecordAction] = [{
        event: EDIT
        label: Edit
        variant: secondary
      }, {
        event: DELETE
        label: Delete
        variant: danger
      }]
        @label "What actions can users take on this record?"
        @description "Buttons on the panel header. One primary at most; the rest collapse past maxInlineActions."
        @synonyms "record actions, detail actions, panel buttons"
        @tier "presentation"
      maxInlineActions : number = 3
        @label "How many actions before collapsing?"
        @description "Actions beyond this count collapse into a '⋯' overflow menu."
        @synonyms "inline actions limit, overflow threshold"
        @tier "presentation"
      showActions : boolean = true
        @label "Show the action buttons?"
        @description "Set false for a read-only record view; a panel with actions nothing listens to is a dead affordance."
        @synonyms "read only, hide actions, view only"
        @tier "presentation"
      ;; Field NAMES, not binding paths. A path knob (`subtitleBinding:
      ;; @entity.company`) makes the consumer responsible for an @entity field
      ;; this atom never sets — an ORB_BINDING_ENTITY_FIELD_NEVER_SET and an
      ;; empty subtitle, which is exactly what the first migration of std-crm

      ;; (set) itself off the payload, so the trap cannot be reintroduced.
      titleField : string = name
        @label "Which field is the record's title?"
        @description "Name of the field on the loaded record shown as the panel title (e.g. contactName, subject, title)."
        @synonyms "title field, heading field, name field, label field"
        @tier "presentation"
      subtitleField : string = description
        @label "Which field is the subtitle?"
        @description "Name of the field shown under the title (e.g. company, category). Set to \"\" for no subtitle at all — the right choice for the document look, whose metadata lives in the properties strip, not a second line."

        @synonyms "open on click, slide over, row click, blank until opened, list embedded"
        @tier "policy"
      detailLook : "panel" | "slide-over" | "page" | "document" = panel
        @label "Detail look"
        @description "Visual treatment for the record surface. panel = an inline detail-panel in the page flow (bodyContent); slide-over = the same panel as a right-hand drawer over the list behind it (slideOverBodyContent); page = a full-width record page with roomier spacing (pageBodyContent); document = a wiki-page/note/article surface — big editable title over a rich-text body, no labelled field rows, click-to-edit with autosave (documentBodyContent / documentEditingContent). Selecting a look swaps which body tree renders after the record loads; any body may still be overridden directly at the call site."
        @synonyms "detail style, drawer, slide over, full page, document, wiki page, note, article"
        @tier "presentation"
      contentField : string = content
        @label "Which field holds the document body?"
        @description "Name of the field on the loaded record that carries the rich-text HTML body the document look renders and edits (e.g. content, body, articleText)."
        @synonyms "body field, content field, document field"
        @tier "presentation"
      coverField : string = ""

        @synonyms "cover field, hero image field, banner field"
        @tier "presentation"
      iconField : string = ""

        @synonyms "icon field, glyph field"
        @tier "presentation"
      editLabel : string = "Edit"
        @label "Edit button label"
        @description "Label of the quiet button above the document body that starts an editing session (the body itself is also clickable)."
        @tier "presentation"
      allowEdit : boolean = true
        @label "Allow editing the document?"
        @description "When false the document look is a pure read surface: no header Edit button, no click-to-edit body, no click-to-rename title. Hosts pass a role condition here so read-only viewers get the page without its authoring affordances; the entity's own access predicates stay the enforcement floor."
        @synonyms "read only document, viewer mode, can edit, editing allowed"
        @tier "policy"
      doneLabel : string = "Done"

        @tier "internal"
      pageBodyContent : render-ui = {
        children: [{
          actions: @config.actions
          entity: ?data
          fields: @config.fields
          initialData: ?data
          maxInlineActions: @config.maxInlineActions

          showActions: @config.showActions

        @label "Page look body"
        @description "Render-ui SExpr rendered after the record loads when detailLook = page: a full record page, width-capped so field rows do not stretch past a readable measure (Almadar_UI_Beauty.md §3)."
        @tier "internal"
      documentBodyContent : render-ui = {
        actions: @config.actions
        coverImage: @entity.coverUrl
        icon: @entity.iconName
        editEvent: (if @config.allowEdit EDIT_CONTENT null)
        editLabel: @config.editLabel
        id: @entity.id
        maxInlineActions: @config.maxInlineActions
        placeholder: @config.placeholder
        subtitle: @entity.description
        title: @entity.name
        titleCommitEvent: (if @config.allowEdit TITLE_COMMITTED null)
        type: document-panel
        value: @entity.content
        className: "w-full"

        @label "Document look body (reading)"
        @description "Render-ui SExpr for detailLook = document while reading: the pure writing surface — editable title with the rich-text body DIRECTLY beneath it, Edit and the actions menu tucked into the header corner. Metadata never sits between title and content; compose the sibling RecordItemDetails trait beside this one for the settings rail. Binds only @entity fields, never ?data, because it is also painted by arms whose payload is not the record."
        @tier "internal"
      documentEditingContent : render-ui = {
        actions: @config.actions
        coverImage: @entity.coverUrl
        icon: @entity.iconName
        autosaveHint: @config.autosaveHint
        contentChangeEvent: CONTENT_CHANGE
        doneEvent: DONE_EDITING
        doneLabel: @config.doneLabel
        editing: true
        id: @entity.id
        maxInlineActions: @config.maxInlineActions
        placeholder: @config.placeholder
        subtitle: @entity.description
        title: @entity.name
        titleCommitEvent: TITLE_COMMITTED
        type: document-panel
        value: @entity.content
        className: "w-full"
      }
        @label "Document look body (editing)"
        @description "Render-ui SExpr for detailLook = document during an editing session: the same surface with the body live and the header corner showing the autosave hint + Done. Binds only @entity fields, never ?data."
        @tier "internal"
    }
  }

  ;; The document's info panel — an on-demand DRAWER, never page furniture:
  ;; the composing organism routes the doc's loaded event into SHOW_DETAILS
  ;; (which only stashes the row) and a "Details" action on the document's
  ;; menu into OPEN_DETAILS, which slides the panel in from the right over
  ;; the content. The drawer's X / backdrop dismiss emits CLOSE back to this
  ;; trait. A sibling of RecordItemDetail: the organism just MOUNTS this
  ;; trait and wires the two listens — no layout wiring.
  ;; EDITING metadata is not done here: it rides the document's "⋯" menu as
  ;; normal actions (the settings modal, favorite/status workflows). The
  ;; META_CHANGE → META_SAVED commit circuit stays available for a call-site
  ;; detailsContent override that opts back into in-place editing.
  trait RecordItemDetails -> @rebindable RecordItem [interaction, instance] {
    initial: idle

    state idle {
      INIT -> idle
      ;; stash only — the drawer opens on demand, never on load
      SHOW_DETAILS -> idle
        (set @entity.loadedRow (object/merge ?data {}))
      OPEN_DETAILS -> showing
        (render-ui drawer @config.detailsContent)
      ;; validator self-loop; the real consumer is the host's persistor.
      META_SAVED -> idle
    }

    state showing {
      ;; a refetch echo while the drawer is open repaints it in place
      SHOW_DETAILS -> showing
        (set @entity.loadedRow (object/merge ?data {}))
        (render-ui drawer @config.detailsContent)
      OPEN_DETAILS -> showing
        (render-ui drawer @config.detailsContent)
      ;; the drawer X / backdrop dismiss
      CLOSE -> idle
        (render-ui drawer null)
      ;; navigation must never strand an open drawer over the next page
      INIT -> idle
        (render-ui drawer null)
      META_CHANGE -> showing
        (emit META_SAVED { id: ?id, patch: ?patch })
    }

    emits {
      META_SAVED -> external {
        id : string!
        patch : RecordItem
      }
        @description "A property in the settings rail committed in place; patch carries the row id plus the one changed field, ready to hand straight to a persist update. Quiet contract: the host persists without refetching or repainting the open document."
        @synonyms "property saved, metadata changed, field committed, update property"
        @tier "domain"
      RELATION_OPEN -> external {
        field : string!
        id : string!
        name : string
      }
        @description "A relation chip in the details drawer was clicked (a tag, the author, the category); id is the linked row's id. Hosts route it to the linked record's own surface — a navigate, a scoped overlay, a filtered list."
        @synonyms "open relation, linked record clicked, tag clicked, chip clicked"
        @tier "domain"
    }

    listens {
      SHOW_DETAILS {
        data : RecordItem
      }
        @description "The document finished loading; stash the row the details drawer will show. Hosts route the doc trait's RecordItemLoaded (or SlugLoaded first element) here."
        @synonyms "record loaded, show metadata, populate details"
        @tier "domain"
      OPEN_DETAILS {
        id : string
      }
        @description "Open the details drawer. Hosts route the document's Details action (e.g. Doc.VIEW_INFO) here."
        @synonyms "show info, open details, document info, page info"
        @tier "presentation"
      CLOSE {
        id : string
      }
        @description "Close the details drawer; the drawer chrome's X / backdrop dismiss emits this."
        @synonyms "dismiss, close drawer, hide details"
        @tier "presentation"
      META_CHANGE {
        id : string
        patch : RecordItem
      }
        @description "A property in the rail committed (switch toggled, select changed, text blurred)."
        @synonyms "property changed, metadata edited, field committed"
        @tier "domain"
    }

    config {
      metaFields : [MetaFieldSpec] = []
        @label "Which metadata properties appear in the details drawer?"
        @description "The record's metadata shown as read-only INFO in the details drawer (Updated, address, status, …). Editing metadata is a normal action under the document's menu, not an inline affordance here."
        @synonyms "properties, metadata fields, document info, page info, front matter"
        @tier "presentation"
      detailsTitle : string = Details
        @label "Details drawer heading"
        @description "Heading of the settings card (e.g. Details, Page info, Document settings)."
        @tier "presentation"
      detailsContent : render-ui = {
        entity: @entity.loadedRow
        fields: @config.metaFields
        relationEvent: RELATION_OPEN
        title: @config.detailsTitle
        type: document-details
      }
        @label "Details drawer content tree"
        @description "Render-ui SExpr painted into the drawer slot on OPEN_DETAILS; binds the row stashed by SHOW_DETAILS. Info-only by default — no metaCommitEvent, so every row displays rather than edits (editing rides the document's actions menu). Override at the call site to extend the panel or to opt into in-place commits via metaCommitEvent: META_CHANGE."
        @tier "internal"
    }
  }

  page "/recorditems" as RecordItemDetailPage -> RecordItemDetail, RecordItemDetails
}
